svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Buy 22 mm ground rod, f7 tolerance, 200 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chamfer the tip 0.5 mm; the tip face stays flat and square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 7 mm cross hole 18 mm below the top end, through the centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 6 mm ball-lock pin passes through it with 1 mm of play, so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plunger can float in line with the bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr the cross hole so it cannot score the bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the top 30 mm goes into the coupling; the rest runs in the bore

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with 0.05 to 0.10 mm diametral clearance and no seal.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: measure the rod at three places; 21.95 to 21.98 mm.
